result.title: DualCast: Dual-Image Conditioned Diffusion Transformers for Digital Human E-Commerce Video Generation
result.summary: Recent advances in world models for game interaction and control have increased the demand for large-scale gameplay videos paired with camera trajectories. However, capturing synchronized camera trajectories often requires game-specific pipelines, limiting scalability. We therefore propose GameWeaver, a unified diffusion framework that automatically produces paired video--camera data through three complementary tasks: camera pose estimation from observed video, video generation along a prescribed camera trajectory, and joint video--camera generation from a reference image and text. First, each tipxel stores the normalized 3D coordinates of a pixel ray's endpoint in a reference coordinate frame. The resulting three-channel tipxel fields and RGB frames share the pretrained video model's VAE. Next, a fully trainable dual-stream Transformer exchanges appearance and geometry features through bidirectional gated attention and conditions both streams on shared text features. Finally, deterministic fitting recovers camera intrinsics and normalized trajectories from generated tipxel fields. In our evaluation tasks, GameWeaver achieves a normalized translation MSE of 0.0029 for camera control; for joint generation, it scores 85.48 out of 100 on instruction adherence versus 64.71 for the best cascade on that metric, validating the feasibility of the proposed approach.

AI.brief_summary: 材料中的摘要描述的是 GameWeaver：用共享 VAE 的 tipxel 三通道场与双流 Transformer 联合生成游戏视频与相机轨迹，与标题所指的数字人电商视频生成不一致。
AI.relevance_reason: 摘要内容属视频/相机轨迹生成与几何场表示，未涉及 VLM 推理状态、证据筛选、停止决策或 latent 使用，也未见可供核查的 LVR 借鉴线索；且标题与摘要明显不符，材料本身存在矛盾。
